Text: WHEN the POS sends a completed purchase event, the loyalty service shall create a pending points transaction for the member.
The loyalty service shall show all members their points history in the customer mobile app.
Rationale: Members ask support for their history (S-03).

Text: WHEN the member opens the balance screen, the customer mobile app shall display the posted points balance.
Rationale: Members check their balance after paying.

Text: WHEN the loyalty service posts points, the customer mobile app shall show the new balance quickly.
Rationale: Members check the app right after paying.

Text: WHEN a member opens the points history, the customer mobile app shall list the member's points transactions with the newest first.
Rationale: Support tickets ask for a history view (S-03).
